title: Four more untested crypto cross-section ideas (batch)
registered: 2026-10-20, after Gen253, before any Gen254 number
common: as Gen253: 20 Binance perps, daily at 00:00 UTC, long the 4 highest / short the 4 lowest scores, 0.125 each, >= 10 coins, 5 bp + funding; same pass rule (sleeve bars + strict rule vs v7)
A_oi_growth: score = -log(open-interest value today / 7 days ago) (leverage build-up underperforms; cross-sectional version of the rejected time-series fade)
B_taker_imbalance: score = 7-day mean of daily perp taker imbalance (2 x taker buy - volume) / volume; long high (persistent aggressive buying)
C_illiquidity: score = 30-day mean of |daily return| / daily quote volume (Amihud); long illiquid, short liquid
D_toptrader_change: score = 7-day change of the top-trader long/short position ratio (sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio, daily last); long rising (smart-money positioning). DEV from the metrics start
